content.text: The test failure points at the theme, not `Board.tsx`. The `MuiTab` override in `src/theme.ts` uses `'&$selected'`, which is JSS-only syntax. Emotion ignores it, so the bold style never applies. The guide's fix is `&.Mui-selected`. I'll make that one-selector change in `theme.ts` and leave the `createTheme(adaptV4Theme(...))` structure alone.
